content: कौपीनम् [कूप-खञ्; see <ls>Sk.</ls> on शालीनकौपीने अधृष्टाकार्ययोः <ls>P. V. 2. 20</ls>] .²1 The pudenda. .²2 A privity, privy part. .²3 A small piece of cloth (usually a small strip worn over the privities; कौपीनं शतखण्डजर्जरतरं कन्था पुनस्तादृशी <ls>Bh. 3. 101.</ls>) .²4 (Hence sometimes) A ragged or tattered garment. .²5 Sin, an improper or wrong act; नाच्छादयति कौपीनं न दंशमशकापहम् <ls>Pt. 3. 97</ls>.
